svg.title: Hexane — scope-qualified n-hexane reference
svg.desc: The main film-preparation method explicitly specifies n-hexane; the SI optical-stability procedure says hexane without an independent isomer specification. Solvent purity is unreported. The reused n-hexane molecular model is a reference, not measured source geometry or proof of the optical solvent isomer.

g.text: Film method specifies n-hexane; solvent purity is unreported.
SI optical isomer unreported; n-hexane model is illustrative.
